title: Mind the End of the Line
prompt: The satchel holds 3 crates — slots 0, 1, 2. Sort each reach: a real slot, or off the end?

items.reveal: Slots are 0, 1, 2. There is no slot 3 — 'Index out of range'.
-1 is the last crate — always a real slot, as long as the satchel isn't empty.
-3 reaches the first crate; -4 falls off the front of the line.
